reason: AgentSoul is primarily a local memory and context layer for DeepSeek Harness, providing persistent personality files, cross-session conversation memory, context injection, and optional LLM-based memory distillation.

summaries.zh: AgentSoul 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供本地人格文件、跨会话记忆、状态管理与上下文注入，并支持可选的记忆蒸馏。
summaries.en: AgentSoul adds local personality files, cross-session memory, state management, context injection, and optional LLM-based memory distillation to DeepSeek Harness.

capabilities: Stores user and assistant text in local SQLite or JSON memory files
Injects configured personality, state, and memory into model context
Registers tools to inspect, search, distill, clear memory, and reload personality files
May call the Harness LLM or an optionally configured OpenAI-compatible HTTP endpoint for memory distillation
